title: Finish the next zSSH public plugin release increment
completion_criteria: Make a material production-grade code/config/workflow change that advances the self-hosted public OpenAI plugin route: OAuth/pairing/revocation, stable HTTPS MCP, plugin-safe capability boundaries, submission package or end-to-end readiness evidence. Preserve the existing private zSSH flow and never replace self-hosting with a Zennay-operated command relay. Tests or live workflow evidence are required.

title: Harden the permanent VPS-first deploy lane
completion_criteria: Implement and validate the next reliability increment for the permanent zCloud VPS-first deploy lane, keeping rollback/LKG/canary protections and avoiding temporary cross-project bridges. Completion requires code/workflow changes plus green automated evidence.

title: Implement automatic worker lanes from project type and backlog
completion_criteria: Implement a deterministic lane generator that derives non-overlapping execution lanes from project type, current backlog and claims, with regression tests proving it avoids duplicate/conflicting write scopes.

title: Implement evidence-based project telemetry adapters
completion_criteria: Implement the adapter interface and at least one real project adapter so zCloud can distinguish latest/current/best validated progress using timestamped sources. Add tests and preserve generic fallback for projects without adapters.

title: Build the central structured worker event stream
completion_criteria: Implement structured worker/task/validation/resource events with correlation IDs and a central read path for dashboard/debugging. Include migration-safe storage and regression tests.

title: Harden browser worker conversation and duplicate-send reliability
completion_criteria: Implement a concrete browser-runner reliability increment around deterministic conversation identity, reconnect, generation-boundary detection or duplicate-send prevention, with regression tests and no impact on unrelated tabs.

title: Advance FTMO through the next preregistered safe generation gate
completion_criteria: Advance the current FTMO generation by implementing or executing the next allowed preregistered code/config/workflow gate on the self-hosted path. Preserve provider provenance, frozen split, development/walk-forward/final-holdout isolation, zero paid cloud and paper-only safety. Completion requires a material persisted change plus deterministic test/workflow evidence; do not inspect sealed outcomes early.

title: Make FTMO the primary useful-compute consumer and prove CPU attribution
completion_criteria: Use the existing FTMO autonomous service/controller path to prove whether current VPS CPU is useful FTMO research compute versus HaxLab or unattributed/control-plane work. If FTMO is not receiving useful compute, make a safe runtime/config change through the Claude/VPS execution lane that restores FTMO throughput without weakening research gates; persist cgroup/host-share attribution plus an advanced FTMO controller/runtime receipt. Diagnosis alone is not completion.

title: Make Raise AI gateway deployment and live smoke verification repeatable
completion_criteria: Implement the next idempotent deploy/restart/live-smoke automation increment for Raise AI so merged gateway code can be proven live without manual shell sequences. Keep secrets server-side and add regression/workflow evidence.

title: Implement the next scoped smart-home connector increment
completion_criteria: Implement a bounded, testable connector increment for the smart_home route without exposing broad arbitrary execution. Add authorization/failure-path tests and keep the existing zCloud/current-info/AI routing intact.

title: Build the Supa production mobile UI foundation
completion_criteria: Implement a material mobile-first production UI/state increment in the canonical Supa app, preserving the validated planner-first and budget-first flow. Completion requires code plus automated build/test evidence.

title: Connect the Supa planner flow to real app state
completion_criteria: Implement typed state and persistence through the planner flow so onboarding/budget/planning decisions survive navigation and can drive downstream grocery/recipe logic. Add tests for the critical state transitions.

title: Implement the next recipe and offer engine slice
completion_criteria: Implement a deterministic production slice that converts grocery/offer data into planner-ready recipe or basket choices with explicit savings data, typed boundaries and regression tests.

title: Build the next Closed-Loop Evaluation Arena v2 implementation increment
completion_criteria: Make a material code/config/workflow change that advances Closed-Loop Evaluation Arena v2 on the current HaxLab implementation branch, with deterministic fixed-seed rollout behavior and green automated tests/workflow evidence. Read-only inspection, status, audit, checklist or documentation-only work does not complete this item.

title: Implement the frozen multi-source evaluation suite v2
completion_criteria: Implement versioned tooling/config that selects and freezes multiple disjoint replay sources with deterministic seeds, provenance and regression coverage; produce a reproducible evaluation manifest/artifact and green tests. Merely inspecting or describing candidate sources is not completion.

title: Implement guard-independence as a mandatory Arena v2 promotion gate
completion_criteria: Add or complete executable guard-intervention/role-leash/recovery-dependency metrics and fail-closed promotion logic, with regression tests proving a guard-dependent challenger cannot pass. Requires code plus test/workflow evidence; audit-only work does not count.

title: Implement versioned rollout/recovery dataset generation
completion_criteria: Implement a deterministic versioned pipeline that persists model-visited failures/recovery states separately from raw human evidence, with provenance, idempotent reruns and automated tests or bounded workflow evidence. Read-only analysis is insufficient.
